title: Overview
subtitle: This hub's status. Changes are written back to hub.json on the hub machine.
hub_id_hint: Use it to confirm it's this hub when linking or pairing
connection_footer: Use the plain port only on your LAN or VPN; expose only the TLS port to the internet.
plain_listen_hint: HTTP port the app and web use on your local network
public_url_hint: Address in the pairing QR code (public_url)
tls_listen_hint: HTTPS / WSS. Internet access and linked hubs use only this port
fingerprint_hint: Apps use this to recognize this hub. If the key changes, devices have to pair again
tls_off_hint: Without TLS there's no safe internet access and no linking with other hubs
endpoints_footer: Addresses the hub found locally or was configured with. After sign-in the app gets them and uses one it can reach. Being listed doesn't mean they're reachable from the internet.
add_first_body: This hub isn't connected to any other computer yet. One hub is all you need: install the node service on your other computers, then add them here. Pick "Computer connects" for laptops and "Hub connects" for servers and dev workstations.
name: Name
name_hint: The name the app and other hubs see
name_default_hint: No name set; using the default "{name}"
endpoints_empty: No candidate addresses. Check public.advertise and the network interface addresses.
doctor_ran: Checked {time}. Read-only, no config changes; doesn't test whether the internet can reach the hub.
doctor_footer: Same as running personad hub doctor on the hub machine: config, TLS certificate, candidate addresses, IPv6, firewall. Read-only.
